reels.title: AV-GRPO: Modality-Anchored Decoupling Diffusion Reinforcement Learning for Joint Audio-Video Generation

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper focuses on joint audio-video generation, which hits the high-velocity 'multimodal_diffusion' category (1.72x multiplier). It addresses the core technical problem of aligning sight and sound, perfect for visual-heavy 3Blue1Brown-style motion graphics.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: How do we teach an AI to 'hear' the rhythm of a video before it even starts generating the footage?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A conductor leading an orchestra where the musicians are playing in different rooms; the model acts as the metronome keeping them perfectly in sync.
